author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: अंतकालस्मरणस्य फलोक्तेरुपयोगमाह ॥  तस्मादिति ।  नित्यं मत्स्मृतेः मत्प्राप्तिहेतुचरमकालीनमत्स्मरणकारणत्वादित्यर्थः ।  मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिः सन्युध्यस्व ॥ ८.७॥
translation:
Therefore, at all times remember Me and fight; having set thy mind and heart upon Me, thou shalt only come to Me; and there is no doubt. (7)
V. Therefore: since the constant and daily contemplation of Me is the way to remember Me at the last moment of life which memory brings the soul to Me. (7.)
A. The preparation of the mind spoken of above is more clearly stated as follows:
